title: Jomboy omni-channel campaign reporting on Listener.com: one place to sell, report and renew
summary: A short LinkedIn promo for Listener.com's omni-channel campaign reporting, quoting Jomboy's VP of Sponsorship Sales. The pitch is that sponsor campaigns across audio, YouTube and social are reported in one place, giving sales teams what they need to sell and renew.

principles.text: Put every podcast, video and clip in one report so sponsors see the full campaign.
principles.quote: Every podcast, video and clip, all in one place.

principles.text: Reporting is a sales tool: give your team what it needs to sell, report and renew with confidence.
principles.quote: Everything your team needs to sell, report, and renew with confidence.

principles.text: Use a partner's own words as proof; a named VP describing the unlock does the selling.
principles.quote: A huge unlock for our partners.

principles.text: Make the call to action small: a 15-minute booking for teams running multi-channel sponsor campaigns.
principles.quote: Running sponsor campaigns across audio, YouTube and social? Book 15 minutes with us.
